scope: Second theory domain beyond tree level: R(e+e- -> hadrons) with massless QCD corrections through alpha_s^4 (PDG eqs. 9.7-9.9), the renormalization-scale dependence derived from the RGE (PDG eq. 9.3), alpha_s(m_Z) from PDG Table 1.1, and three separate uncertainty objects (scale envelope, truncation estimate, parametric alpha_s). Validity: photon exchange only, n_f = 5 massless quarks, Q well above the b threshold and well below m_Z.
exclusions: Z exchange, gamma-Z interference and QED corrections
Quark-mass and non-perturbative corrections; flavour-threshold matching
Any experiment, detector, data or blinding field; no comparison with measured R
Claims of formal proof or of coverage of the scale envelope

capabilities.name: scale-dependent-coefficients
capabilities.scope: SymPy derivation of d_n(L) from c_1..c_4 and the RGE; d_n(0) = c_n; truncated series mu-independent through its order; nf = 5 values of c_2, c_3, c_4 (perturbative argument, not formal proof)

capabilities.name: higher-order-prediction
capabilities.scope: R(Q) at orders alpha_s^0..alpha_s^4 with the scale envelope, truncation estimate and parametric alpha_s variation reported separately
